F1.finding: Ahliya declines more than half of the eligible self-employed applicants.
F1.evidence: data/income_audit.csv: recorded income against income verified by an auditor, for 600 reviewed applications.

F2.finding: Eligible applicants who live in a family home are declined about twice as often as eligible renters.
F2.evidence: data/ahliya_train.csv.gz: officers' decisions by tenure, before and after the rule change of July 2024.

F3.finding: Ahliya's false negative rate is highest in Qassim.
F3.evidence: data/ahliya_scored_test.csv: the officers' decisions against the reviewed outcome, by office and gender.

F4.finding: The model was approved on a reported accuracy that the audit does not reproduce.

F5.finding: The next version of Ahliya will be retrained on the applications it handled this year.
F5.evidence: data/ahliya_deployment_log.csv: which applications received a reviewed label.
